topics.title: Statistical techniques and measures of central tendency

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish measures of central tendency, dispersion and relationship by what each one describes.
Explain why a measure of central tendency is a representative figure for a data set.

topics.title: Mean from ungrouped data: direct and indirect methods

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate the mean of ungrouped data by the direct method.
Calculate the mean of ungrouped data by coding with an assumed mean.

topics.title: Mean from grouped data: direct and indirect methods

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate the mean of a frequency distribution using class midpoints.
Calculate the mean of grouped data from deviations about an assumed mean group.

topics.title: Median for ungrouped and grouped data

concepts.learning_objective: Locate the median of an arranged series using the (N+1)/2 th item.
Compute the median of grouped data with cumulative frequencies and the median formula.
Identify the mode of an ungrouped series.
Classify a series as unimodal, bimodal, trimodal, multimodal or without mode.

topics.title: Comparison of mean, median and mode

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the normal curve and the coincidence of mean, median and mode in it.
Interpret the relative positions of mean, median and mode in skewed distributions.
